answer: A protocol maps each identity to a bonded delta of staked collateral, where duplicate addresses in one canyon face quadratic slashing if their votes diverge or misreport. Creating k Sybil nodes requires capital growing as alpha times i squared, so marginal cost alpha(2k plus 1) rises super-linearly against bounded extraction V. Zero-knowledge verifiable delay ties each grove of validators to a time-locked proof, making attack expected utility V minus marginal cost minus slashed stake negative and sustaining a robust Nash equilibrium.
